## Tutorials

- [6 Steps to Create and Publish a Modern Javascript and Typescript Library in 2024](https://jfmelo.com/tutorials/6-steps-to-create-and-publish-a-modern-javascript-and-typescript-library-in-2024/index.md): All you need to create and share your Javascript or Typescript library with the Open-source community.
- [7 Ways You Can Contribute to Open-source Projects](https://jfmelo.com/tutorials/7-ways-you-can-contribute-to-open-source-projects/index.md): There are several ways to contribute to open-source projects, even if you are not a developer.

## Open source

- [k9s](https://jfmelo.com/open-source/k9s/index.md): A powerful terminal UI for Kubernetes that makes managing clusters feel fast, intuitive, and actually enjoyable.
- [n8n](https://jfmelo.com/open-source/n8n/index.md): The best visual workflow automation editor that connects to almost everything.
- [sqlmap](https://jfmelo.com/open-source/sqlmap/index.md): Automatic SQL injection and database takeover tool.
- [PostgREST](https://jfmelo.com/open-source/postgrest/index.md): Automagically generate a production-ready REST APIs from any PostgreSQL database.
